svg.title: A top view can hide a height difference
svg.desc: Conceptual top and front views of two straight paths with the same X and Y coordinates but different Z heights. They overlap in top view and separate in front view. The illustration is not a screenshot or clearance approval.

g.text: Use a second view to reveal height
Two paths can occupy the same place on screen without being at the same Z.
Both paths overlap in this view.
The picture does not reveal the height gap.
Check the actual heights and surrounding setup.
Conceptual illustration • colors are explanatory, not the application's palette.
Changing the view changes the picture; it does not change any programmed coordinate.
